items.summary:
The brother of Hayden Panettiere ’s on-off boyfriend, Brian Hickerson , is sharing an update on how he is doing following her tragic death in August .

“I spent almost eight to 10 weeks up in Greenville [South Carolina] around him,” Zach Hickerson said in an interview with TMZ published on Friday, November 27. “One word that comes to mind is just distraught, heartbroken, confused. I know that there’s still a certain level of shock and surrealness to him of that. There’s just no resolve to this. This isn’t, like, a legal thing. This isn’t a breakup thing. … It’s a definitive thing, and there’s no fixing [it]. There’s no resolve.”

“He’s, one, navigating the loss [and] two … trying to look ahead at the next chapter of his life or the rest of his life. Like, what now?” Zach, 39, continued. “Given all that’s happened, given the reputation, I just know that he’s carrying a lot. Rightfully so, to an extent.”

Panettiere was pronounced dead at the scene after authorities responded to a 911 call at an Airbnb in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16. The Heroes actress was staying at the residence with Brian, 37. Zach was also present.

Brother of Hayden Panettiere's Ex Recalls Her Last Moments Before Death 

“I know that he’s heartbroken,” Zach shared on Friday. “I’ve tried to be there as much as I can for him. About three or four weeks ago, I realized that, man, I was probably trying to carry a little bit too much for everyone else and had not really dealt with the grief and loss myself. So I’ve taken the last two to three weeks to really kind of be on my own, so it’s hard for…
items.t: Hayden Panettiere's Ex Brian Hickerson 'Distraught' After Her Death

Princess Kate Middleton has been named patron of leading cancer hospital The Christie more than two years after going public with her own cancer battle .

Kensington Palace said in a statement on Friday, November 27, “The announcement follows Her Royal Highness’s visit to The Christie’s Withington site in June 2026, where she met patients, families and staff and learned more about the hospital’s internationally renowned approach to supporting people living with and beyond cancer.”

The Christie in Manchester, England, is one of the world’s leading cancer treatment centers and the largest of its kind in Europe.

“The patronage reflects the Princess of Wales’s longstanding interest in the role that emotional, social and physical well-being play in cancer patients’ journeys, and her commitment to highlighting the importance of holistic care alongside world-class clinical treatment,” Kensington Palace said. “Building on her recent work exploring recovery, resilience and life beyond diagnosis, the patronage reflects a shared belief in supporting the whole person throughout their cancer journey and beyond.”

Jen Affleck and her estranged husband, Zac Affleck , have revealed the sex of their fourth baby.

In a sweet Instagram post uploaded on Thursday, November 26, Jen, 27, Zac, 30, and their three kids got involved in the beach picnic gender reveal. (Jen and Zac are already parents to daughters Nora, 5, and Penelope, 16 months, and son Luca, 3.)

The family cut into a cake with wine glasses, revealing that Jen and Zac are expecting another daughter.

“Our story may be changing, but the love we have for our babies never will. 🤍we love you baby girl,” the caption accompanying the post read.

Pregnant Jen Affleck Bares Bump in Bikini During Solo Babymoon Amid Divorce 

Jen announced in June that the pair were expanding their family by sharing a carousel of photos where she showed off her baby bump. “Chapter Four. 🤍,” the  Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star wrote alongside the post.

Months later, the duo dropped the bombshell that they had split, with Jen filing for divorce on November 3 after seven years of marriage.

Jen exclusively told Us on November 10 that her pregnancy was one of the catalysts that led her to choose to end her marriage, insisting that “the same reason why I filed for divorce is the same reason why it was really hard.”

“It was this fourth child. I had to ask myself very hard questions like, ‘Is this the type of relationship I want this child to look up to?’” she told Us . “When I realized it was a no, that’s when I realized that I needed to make a change. You’ll see a lot of that unfold in season [1 of the Orange County spinoff].”

items.t: Jen Affleck, Estranged Husband Zac and Kids Reveal Gender of Baby No. 4

items.title: Taylor Swift Seemingly Skips Chiefs' Thanksgiving Day Game Against Bills
items.summary:
Taylor Swift appeared to celebrate Turkey Day away from the throngs of Bills Mafia.  

Swift, 36, seemingly skipped watching husband Travis Kelce and the Kansas City Chiefs play in Buffalo against the Bills on Thursday, November 26.  

Her absence continued a trend of the pop star deciding against traveling to road games as a member of Chiefs Kingdom. Swift has attended every Chiefs home game in person this season.  

The Bills led the Chiefs, 7-3, at halftime at the time of publication.  

Every Time Taylor Swift Attended an NFL Game to Cheer for Travis Kelce 

Earlier this week, New York Knicks superstar Jalen Brunson exclusively discussed Swift’s sports fandom with Us, which came on the heels of his teammate, Tyler Kolek , arguing that her support of the Knicks during the 2026 NBA Finals was “performative.” 

Brunson, 30, said Swift is “obviously” a welcome member of the team’s fanbase. 

ORCHARD PARK, NEW YORK: Jerrod Carmichael and Taylor Swift at the AFC Divisional Playoff game between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Buffalo Bills at Highmark Stadium on January 21, 2024 in Orchard Park, New York. Al Bello/Getty Images 
 “I can’t believe I have to say this,” Brunson noted. “But I didn’t say what was said. Being one of the leaders of the team — the captain of the team — I guess I now have to help somebody out. Yes, she’s a member of the Knicks fandom. Yes, she is.” 

Kelce recently reflected on Swift showing up to her first Chiefs game in the early stages of their relationship in September 2023.  

“I’m a lucky man,” the tight end told ESPN in a Wednesday, November 18,…
items.t: Taylor Swift Seemingly Skips Chiefs' Thanksgiving Day Game Against Bills

items.title: Melissa Gilbert Is ‘Grateful’ for Supporters After Timothy Busfield Claims
items.summary:
Melissa Gilbert expressed her gratitude for the support she and her family received while her husband, Timothy Busfield , faced allegations of child sex abuse.

Taking to Instagram on Thursday, November 26, Gilbert, 62, shared a message of thanks following a challenging year.

“This Thanksgiving I’m incredibly grateful for all those who came running toward us this year,” she wrote alongside an image of a turkey surrounded by fruits and vegetables. “To those who checked in, took care of our home and animals when we were away, came to hearings, fed us, housed us, spoke up, testified, wrote letters, listened, comforted us, held our hands and checked in regularly, we love you.”

She continued, “Our undying gratitude also, to our extraordinary team who bravely fought and continue to fight for so hard for what is right and true. On this day, as we all acknowledge the blessings in our lives, we send our love and eternal gratitude to each and every one of you. #thanksgiving #gratitude #blessed.”

items.t: Melissa Gilbert Is ‘Grateful’ for Supporters After Timothy Busfield Claims
